title: HandoffRecord
description: AX Harness v1 handoff. Enough state for another session to continue without rebuilding context. Blockers and failed attempts are required keys so that omitting them is impossible: an empty list is an explicit claim that there were none.

completed.description: Work actually finished, as distinct from work attempted.

blockers.description: Empty means there are none, not that the question was skipped.

failedAttempts.description: Recorded so the next session does not repeat them.

validation.description: What was verified, and what was explicitly not verified.
